verdict.rationale: Sampling and retention controls are a fair axis for an observability backend like Honeycomb, but the evidence pack never documents trace or log sampling controls or selectable retention tiers. The only related items are a passing reference to a 'retention period' in the SLO docs and per-plan event-volume caps on the pricing page; neither is a developer-facing control for managing data volume.

support.subject: As a developer, I can control trace/log sampling and retention tiers to manage data volume deliberately
